name: Repress
text: In a fight, each block this weapon makes cancels two unresolved enemy successes, and when the bearer retaliates it resolves its dice before the attacker does.

name: Concealed Position
text: The concealed profile can be used only in the Marksman's first Shoot action of the battle.

name: Assault Shield
text: An operative carrying a dominator maul and assault shield has a 3+ Save instead of 4+.

name: Nuncio-aquila
text: Around the Nuncio-aquila marker (or the Proctor while the marker is off the board), enemies within 3 inches pay 1 extra AP to pick up markers and perform mission actions, and the APL they contribute when control of a marker is worked out counts 1 lower.

name: DEPLOY NUNCIO-AQUILA
text: Not in an enemy control range. Place the Nuncio-aquila marker within 6 inches (horizontally) of the Proctor, or move it up to 6 inches from where it is. If the Proctor leaves the killzone, so does the marker.

name: Medic!
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Exaction Squad operative within 3 inches that the Chirurgant can see would be taken down (neither in an enemy control range), it is left on 1 wound and cannot be taken down for the rest of the action. After the action it may Dash into the Chirurgant's control range, both then have -1 APL until their next activations end, and if it happened in its own activation that activation ends.

name: MEDIKIT
text: Not in an enemy control range. A friendly Exaction Squad operative in this operative's control range, itself included, regains up to 2D3 lost wounds. Whoever Medic! saved this turning point cannot be treated.

name: Handler
text: When the Leashmaster is activated, a ready friendly R-VR Cyber-mastiff may be activated together with it; the two take their actions one at a time in any order.

name: Attack Pattern
text: In turning point 1 the Leashmaster's gambit picks two different patterns for one friendly Cyber-mastiff for the whole battle: Aggressive (its melee weapons have Relentless), Swift (+2 inches Move) or Defensive (Save improved by 1).

name: R-VR COMMAND
text: Pick a friendly Cyber-mastiff anywhere and swap one of its attack patterns for the one it does not have.

name: Beast
text: The Cyber-mastiff can take only Apprehend, Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Guard, Reposition, Pick Up Marker and Place Marker, and uses only the weapon on its datacard.

name: APPREHEND
text: Pick an enemy in this operative's control range. Until it leaves that control range (or this action is used again), its weapons have their Hit worsened by 1 (not stacking with injury) and it cannot Fall Back.

name: Engendered Focus
text: The Castigator ignores changes that would hurt its stats and its weapons' stats (injury included), but not its Save.

name: Zealous Dedication
text: Each time an attack die would inflict 3 or more damage on the Castigator, roll a D6: on a 5+ that die inflicts 1 less.

name: Castigator's Arrest
text: While exactly one enemy is in the Castigator's control range, that enemy cannot Fall Back.

name: Acute Focus
text: Once in each of the Malocator's activations, one Pick Up Marker, Place Marker, VERISCANT or mission action it performs costs 1 AP less.

name: VERISCANT
text: Not in an enemy control range. Pick an enemy the Malocator can see. While a friendly Exaction Squad operative shoots, fights or retaliates against it, its weapons have Lethal 5+ and Severe, until the Malocator's next activation, until it is taken down, or until it uses this again.

name: OPTICS
text: Not in an enemy control range. Until the Marksman's next activation, the executioner shotgun's concealed and stationary profiles have Lethal 5+, and enemies cannot be obscured when it shoots with any executioner shotgun profile.

name: First in the Field
text: In turning point 1 the Revelatum's gambit gives it a free Reposition if it is wholly within your drop zone.

name: SPOT
text: Not in an enemy control range. Pick an enemy the Revelatum can see within 8 inches. Until the end of the turning point, friendly Exaction Squad operatives shooting it have Seek Light with their ranged weapons, and it cannot be obscured against them.

name: Stubborn Subjugator
text: The Subductor ignores changes that would worsen the Hit of its melee weapons.

name: Close Quarters Vigilance
text: The Vigilant may Shoot while in an enemy control range unless it has Charged in the same activation, and always in a counteraction. Guard is unchanged.

name: SIGNAL
text: Not in an enemy control range. Another friendly Exaction Squad operative the Vox-signifier can see gets +1 APL until the end of its next activation.

name: RUTHLESS EFFICIENCY
text: When a friendly Exaction Squad operative shoots (frag and krak grenades aside), friendly Exaction Squad operatives in an enemy's control range do not stop that enemy being chosen as a target.
